soundness_flags.label: def:coupled-fold-learners
soundness_flags.one_line: The construction declares an arbitrary nonnegative fitted function \(\widehat q_{a,-k,n}\) and then sets \(\widehat Q_{a,-k,n}(dy\mid x)=\widehat q_{a,-k,n}(x,y)d\ell_{\mathcal Y}(y)\) as a probability kernel without requiring unit integral; normalization is needed for the OT problem, centering identity, and bias formula.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Conjecture 2 regular regime

accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Efficient uniform Wald inference only for laws and learner sequences satisfying the stated envelope, rate product, and variance-separation conditions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1
